cards.name: Mastercard Titanium
cards.notes: Does not earn points. Edge/CBI First customers get up to 100% back on cinema, streaming, valet (AED 75/150/300 a month at AED 4k/8k/12k spend, to 31 Dec 2026). Profit/interest 3.45%/month. Intl fee 2.99%. CBI KFS for the World Elite Exclusive card confirms 2.99% international fee for CBI cards; these tiers were not on that document.

cards.name: Rewards Platinum
cards.notes: 0.5 CBI Rewards points/AED UAE, 1 abroad; optional AED 525/year Accelerator doubles to 1 UAE and 1.5-2 abroad. Point value not found (placeholder 0.007 gives about 0.35% as aggregator shows). Intl fee 2.99%. CBI KFS for the World Elite Exclusive card confirms 2.99% international fee for CBI cards; these tiers were not on that document.

cards.name: Rewards World
cards.notes: 1 point/AED UAE (1.75 on single UAE transaction of AED 2,000+), 2.5 abroad. Aggregator implies 0.7% at 1 pt/AED, so point value 0.007. Intl fee 2.99%. CBI KFS for the World Elite Exclusive card confirms 2.99% international fee for CBI cards; these tiers were not on that document.

cards.name: World Elite Exclusive

welcome_offer.text: 100,000 miles joining bonus after first spend (CBI schedule of charges, Nov 2025)

cards.notes: From the CBI World Elite Exclusive KFS/schedule (text scrambled): primary annual fee AED 15,750, supplementary 7,875, optional Skywards-linked options up to AED 76,115, FX 2.99% (excl. VAT), interest 2.99%/month, 55 days interest-free. Earn rate not in the document so not modelled; miles tier invite-style product.
